json.summary:
The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) found that data center electricity demand is quickly absorbing the spare generating capacity of regional grids. This text is a synthetic sample that re-narrates that analysis in English; it is not model output. It exists to exercise the runner, the schema and the ledger wiring, so its figures and claims are not subject to fact-checking.
